text:
maria_cs: Flagging a SIG/CAIQ escalation from Alice at Glenwood Finance — due tomorrow. They tried to export audit logs for KMS activity and got an export error referencing HSM. Also reported intermittent 401s on inference API calls and a weird billing credit on their invoice. Sharing details and repro below.

alice_cust: Hi team — export failed when we clicked 'Export audit logs' in the console. Error popup: "Export failed: unable to access key-material (hsm-unavailable)". Also seeing 401s from our frontend to /v1/generate since ~2026-03-16T03:14Z. We need CAIQ evidence (HSM attestation + key rotation logs) for our questionnaire. Due 2026-03-18 EOD.

alex_support: Thanks Alice. Can you paste the exact export error payload and a curl repro if you have one? I'll open a ticket and triage.

maria_cs: Repro steps Alice sent: 1) Org admin -> Settings -> Security -> Audit exports -> Download. 2) Console shows spinner then modal: "export failed: server error". Alice also ran a direct call: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?org=glenwood" -o export.zip
```

And got HTTP/1.1 500 with body: `{"error":"export_failed","reason":"hsm_unavailable","code":500}`. For the 401s they captured sample inference log: `2026-03-16T03:14:22Z GET /v1/generate 401 Authorization failed: token not found`

sam_oncall: Noted. I see a failed rotation job in infra logs around 03:08 UTC for the key-rotor service in us-west-2. Deploy-bot shows: "rotor-job failed: exit code 2 (credential expiry)" at 03:08. Possible the rotor attempted to rewrap keys against HSM and hit transient auth to HSM. I'll check runtime and KMS layer.

deploy-bot: rotor-job-2026-03-16-03:08 failed -> https://infra.internal/rotor/2026-03-16-0308

kevin_security: If the rotor couldn't access HSM during rotation that could block export operations that need key-wrapping verification. For the SIG, we can provide HSM uptime graphs, signed attestation, and key rotation audit CSV. I need to know if Glenwood requires FIPS validation text included. Also: is the export flow failing because we prevent exporting wrapped key material?

maria_cs: Alice, can you confirm whether your security team specifically needs a FIPS or module cert, or if a signed Redwood attestation + KMS access logs will suffice for the questionnaire? I can ask for a 1–2 day extension from them.

alice_cust: We need the CAIQ item that asks for evidence of KMS/HSM usage and rotation. Ideally: last 90 days of key rotation audit, and a signed statement confirming keys are managed in an HSM. FIPS statement optional but preferred. Extension would help.

alex_support: I've created INC-98765 for this. Routing to eng-runtime and security. Ticket: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-98765|INC-98765>. Adding logs and Alice's repro.

sam_oncall: Quick update from ops: rotor job failed due to expired infra credential used by the rotor service at 03:08. We rolled back the rotation attempt and redeployed a fix at 03:22 UTC which restored HSM connectivity. I also restarted the export worker. Can Alice retry the export? If it fails, capture `curl -v` and the full response body.

maria_cs: Assigning attestation to @kevin_security. I'll ask Glenwood for the extension and confirm CAIQ question mapping. ETA for initial attestation draft: 24 hours. :thumbsup:

alice_cust: Retrying now... export completed successfully. Downloaded zip. Thank you. Still waiting on the attestation doc for the CAIQ answer.

kevin_security: Good. I'll draft an attestation that includes: 1) HSM uptime chart for last 90 days, 2) signed statement on key custody, 3) key rotation audit CSV with timestamps and operator IDs, and 4) notes on our KMS integration and fallback behavior. Please send the exact CAIQ question number you need in the doc.

maria_cs: The question is under 'Encryption & Key Management' — they referenced: "Describe evidence of HSM-backed KMS and rotation policies (rotation logs, attestation)". I'll forward the exact text from the customer's SIG.

alex_support: FYI billing anomaly: finance reported the negative credit on their invoice was a delayed test refund. I've looped finance on INC-98765 to confirm final invoice numbers.

maria_cs: Great — next steps: (1) kevin to produce attestation + CSV (24h), (2) alex to confirm billing note in ticket, (3) sam to close any lingering rotor followups in infra. I'll update Glenwood and ask for a 48h extension if needed. I'll post the attestation here when ready. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
